name: mcp.storage.dev
description:
Tigris storage scales infinitely, can be shared across any cloud, and provides instant access to all your data, all over the globe. Tigris MCP Server connects Tigris object storage to your AI tools

- List and manage buckets
- Take and list snapshots of buckets
- Create forks of buckets
- List and manage objects in buckets
- Upload and download objects

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.storage.dev to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.storage.dev to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.storage.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.storage.dev MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.storage.dev lists 19 MCP tools, including tigris_checkpoint, tigris_create_bucket, tigris_create_forks, tigris_create_workspace, tigris_delete_bucket, tigris_delete_object, tigris_get_bucket_details, tigris_get_object, tigris_get_object_details, tigris_get_signed_object_url, tigris_list_buckets, and tigris_list_checkpoints.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.storage.dev?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.storage.dev in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
mcp.storage.dev requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.storage.dev is developed by Tigris Data Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
